statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_feed (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, payload VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO data_feed (payload) SELECT CONCAT('data_', n) FROM (SELECT @rownum := @rownum + 1 AS n FROM (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) t1, (SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) t2, (SELECT @rownum := 0) t3 LIMIT 1000) numbers
